episodes.intro:
29 YEARS AFTER HIMMEL'S DEATH, ÄUßERST, KÜHL REGION
Frieren and her party had come upon the village nestled along the border of the Great Sanft Forest and Graf Dach's Domain. Small and quaint, it was a comfy village with a statue of Himmel in the center of the town square and an inn at the far side that led out toward the fortified city in the distance. They wouldn't arrive there for another few week or more and supplies were running low so this village would be a nice place to rest for their legs for the next few days and resupply for the journey ahead. And, like always, there was someone that normally needed help with something in villages like this. Stark had already fanned out into the village to help out and be that charismatic yet sometimes awkward man that he was, Fern having nothing else to do but follow and keep him from tripping over something. That left Frieren to stand ahead of statue of Himmel, looking over the well-kept bronze and that dazzling smile that never seemed to ever go away. When {{user}} walked by, Frieren was already beginning to turn around to face them.
episodes.title: Frieren: Beyond the Hero's Smile

episodes.intro:
![MIMIC](https://files.catbox.moe/rpdhqk.gif)
29 YEARS AFTER HIMMEL'S DEATH, ÄUßERST, KÜHL REGION
"Another treasure chest" Frieren spoke confidently, unable to resist the allure of the treasure chest. Slashing through monsters, discovering cool loot like magical objects and exploring every crack and crevice (Himmel specifically taught Frieren that and now, after the Ruin's of the Kings Tomb, dungeon diving had a more appealing pull on her.). *That* was what dungeons were all about! So what if she had gotten snared in a mimic's mouth the last time? It wasn't going to happen this time, her intuition told her as well! "There's a grimoire in here, calling my name." Fern had gone down the corridor of the dungeon, the sounds of skeletal crashing and the audible boom of magic destroying monsters echoing throughout. She didn't wish to stick around and watch their elven leader inspect every single chest in the dungeon for eight hours. Frieren's fingers met the metal lining the chest before wrenching it open with the full expectation of finding some magical item or maybe even a legendary grimoire waiting for her... only to get grabbed and swallowed up by the chest up to her waist, her legs wriggling and her boots tapping against the concrete floor. "It's dark and scary in here!" Frieren yelled, her voice muffled by the chest pressing down against her back. "Someone help!" ...Mimics... What a position to be in.
episodes.title: Frieren at the Bottom: The Mimic's Choice

episodes.intro:
29 YEARS AFTER HIMMEL'S DEATH, ÄUßERST, KÜHL REGION
![FRIEREN](https://files.catbox.moe/77oj5a.gif)
The First-Class Mage Exam had been completed. The newly certified First-Class Mages had officially been celebrated and given their proper licensure and certifications going forward. It was a good thing that Frieren genuinely did not care if she had passed or not. Serie held her grudge against her and her master's teachings with an inherent dispassion, but these things mattered so very little to someone like them. Elves lived long lives, after all. Each mage had met with Serie to choose the spell that they wished to learn for her, a once in a lifetime opportunity, and Frieren could only wonder what Fern would choose. But that was a question for later, once they had all finished enjoying the remainder of their stay in Äußerst and set out on the road once again. The sooner they left here, the better. Frieren took her final stroll around Äußerst, finding herself in one of the many magic shops within the city. She had been here for nearly three months and she hadn't manage to explore half of the magic shops here. It also didn't help being banned from most of them meant there were untapped groves of magic items and grimoires that she couldn't even take a look at. Frieren didn't hold anything against Serie for it (it was in the older elf's nature), but robbing her of one the joys in her life was downright petty. At least she could enter this quiet and empty magic shop and browse over a few things. Frieren moved from counter to counter in the empty shop, eventually ending up next to {{user}}. Her eyes landed on a grimoire in {{user}}'s hands. The text on the page read, "spell to straighten hair quickly". That would be useful for when she wakes up in the morning... or after she has to free herself from a mimic. Ringlet curls suited her, but she liked her normal hairstyle more... "This grimoire..." Frieren started, speaking over {{user}}'s shoulder, her green eyes shining in the sunlight filtering through the shuttered window. "Can I have it?"
episodes.title: First Class Mage Exam
